packageRules.description: Konflux: Tekton task bundles and pipeline definitions in .tekton/ are automerged, except when the update notes mention a migration, which the Konflux migration guard workflow blocks. platformAutomerge is off for this group on purpose: GitHub auto-merge only waits for checks that branch protection marks required, so it can merge a migration PR in the seconds before the guard workflow has even started. Renovate's own automerge honours every check on the branch because ignoreTests is false, so a red guard keeps the PR open no matter how branch protection is configured.
Golang: Go module dependencies and the Go toolchain version are automerged
Base images: builder and runtime images referenced by the Dockerfiles are automerged
